mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained low-cost capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market distress that triggers central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering equity underperformance as recession risks increase, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signals real economy contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600.0 thousand units signal weak consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as housing sector weakness spreads to broader economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth above 130,000 thousand persons indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic momentum builds.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment growth above 130,000 thousand persons and unemployment rate decline below 9.5% signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE < 9.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% signals the zero lower bound constraint, triggering expectations of unconventional monetary policy that boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25.
